mapper.sql: select a.*, p.name as pet_name, p.cover_img as pet_cover_img, u.username as username from adopt_application a left join pet p on a.pet_id = p.id left join `user` u on a.user_id = u.id
mapper.insert: insert into adopt_application (pet_id, user_id, applicant_name, phone, address, occupation, has_experience, reason, status, apply_time) values (#{petId}, #{userId}, #{applicantName}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{occupation}, #{hasExperience}, #{reason}, #{status}, #{applyTime})
mapper.select: where a.user_id = #{userId} order by a.apply_time desc
select * from adopt_application where pet_id = #{petId} and user_id = #{userId} and status = '待审核'
